correctness.rationale: All hypotheses and boundary cases are explicit for indexed cyclic lengths n>=5. An occurrence of output 1 fixes an adjacent input pair, which forces one-mark separation >=3. Internal positions in each gap are a path-independent-set word counted by F_(d-2), with F1=F2=1 covering d=3,4; the all-zero fiber is the Lucas cycle-independent-set count. Circular composition double counting proves T_n and U_n exactly, logarithmic derivatives prove their generating functions, and Fibonacci addition proves the sharp runner-up. The extracted standalone verifier checks every input/output through length 17 (262112 output possibilities) and generating-function identities through 122. Computational tests are not substituted for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The data are a natural finite-block deterministically lossy sensor under a one-sided (0,2)-style RLL physical source. The theorem fully separates reachable outputs, exact decoding list sizes, unique-decodability and sharp worst-case ambiguity; it produces an exact optimal noiseless finite-length code size and two distinct entropy scales. The exponential scarcity of singleton outputs and uniquely dominant all-zero observation are useful source/reconstruction distinctions not merely an isolated small count.
